card.name: Physician or prescriber as the one directing
card.fires_on: The word physician after "a" or "the" when a doctor directs or prescribes treatment, and the middle of "Prescribers" (Pres-cri-bers). It also fires on a few military rank words such as Oberleutnant and Officers.

modes.label: Physician as decision-maker
modes.description: The word physician after a/the, in sentences saying a doctor must decide, order or supervise.
modes.example: The decision to have patients moved to home infusion should be made after evaluation and recommendation by a<< physician>>.

modes.label: Inside Prescribers
modes.description: The middle piece of the word Prescribers at the start of dosing-error instructions.
modes.example: Pres<<cri>>bers should calculate the appropriate dose of RET

modes.label: Military officer ranks
modes.description: Rank or officer words in historical military text.

card.plain: It lights up when the text names the doctor or prescriber who is in charge of the treatment.
